identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.6: the saved appearance comes back after a revive (no more missing head), /coat works over MP shirts, and male pieces with no model were removed (Left Ring 5, Wrist Binding 6, MP Accessories 6, 14, 39, 42, 50, 61).

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.107: taking a vehicle out of a garage puts you beside it where you repair it (the Pioneer: next to the basket, no longer under the wing). 0.1.105: a vehicle can say where the player stands to refuel, repair and clean it (the Pioneer: by the fuselage, not at the wing tip). 0.1.104: the garage shows each vehicle's health on a bar. 0.1.103: chamois cloth item (RSG and VORP): wipe a vehicle and it stays clean for an hour; on VORP the repair kit and the cloth are added to the items table by the resource itself. 0.1.102: lock your car with L (cars only), a padlock on the speedometer, vehicles back to their owner after a crash.
